nhs_tier0_layers.clinical_guarantee: Scrubs declared fields plus all 24 OpenCareQ `FORBIDDEN_PID_KEYS` (`nhs_number`, `dob`, `postcode`, etc.) and enforces `assert_zero_pid` (`phi_present == False`) before export.
Verifies sender authenticity plus scoped clinical Run-Grant capability ceilings and NIST FIPS 204 `ML-DSA-65` / `HMAC-SHA256` digests; rejects forged or out-of-scope prescribers.
Binds agent cards to statutory NHS ODS (`QXX`/`UXXXXX`/`GPhC`) ownership + monotonic `version >= 1` anti-rollback & generation-bound withdrawal (`0/10` spoofed cards).
Conserves total `CP 1350` Year-of-Care capitated integer pence while enforcing a `>=25%` `Core20` deprivation ringfence so affluent spot-bids cannot drain IMD Decile 1-2 reserves.
Caps per-observer reputation at `+/-1` per settled pathway AND applies a Slope Index of Inequality (`SII`) parity lock (`equity_ratio >= 0.85`) blocking `E2` cherry-picking rings.
Enforces non-self-attestation (`observer != subject`), binds `G1-G20` / `H-OCQ-01..07` hazard tags, and records verifiable `Paperclip` (`#L<n>`) primary-source pins.

paperclip_tier3_pins.citation: Raskar, R. et al. Beyond DNS: Unlocking the Internet of AI Agents via the NANDA Index and Verified AgentFacts. arXiv:2507.14263 (2025).
paperclip_tier3_pins.verified_fact: Lean <=120-byte index pointers + W3C/JSON-LD AgentFacts (<5 min short-lived credentials) and quilt-like governmental/enterprise split-horizon registry governance.

paperclip_tier3_pins.citation: Osanlou, R., Walker, L., Hughes, D. A., Burnside, G. & Pirmohamed, M. Adverse drug reactions, multimorbidity and polypharmacy: a prospective analysis of 1 month of medical admissions. BMJ Open 12, e055551 (2022). doi:10.1136/bmjopen-2021-055551
paperclip_tier3_pins.verified_fact: ADRs accounted for 16.5% of NHS medical admissions (mean 10.5 vs 7.8 medicines, p<0.01; 40.4% avoidable/possibly avoidable), projecting £2.21 billion/yr annual cost across NHS England.
paperclip_tier3_pins.hal_role: Clinical Motivation for Eliminating Watchtower Alert Fatigue in Polypharmacy Triage

paperclip_tier3_pins.citation: Peeters, S. L. J. et al. Real-world study on fluoropyrimidine-related toxicity outcomes in cancer patients with select DPYD variant alleles that received DPYD genotype-guided dosing. Int. J. Cancer (2025).
paperclip_tier3_pins.verified_fact: DPD deficiency increases severe fluoropyrimidine toxicity 2- to 4-fold and treatment-related mortality 25-fold; heterozygous DPYD*2A/c.2846A>T/DPYD*13/c.1236G>A carriers (~5%) require initial 25-50% dose reduction.
paperclip_tier3_pins.hal_role: Tier 1/3 Grounding for `Track` `quote-llm-truncation` Handover Amnesia Recovery (`G17`)

paperclip_tier3_pins.citation: U.S. Food and Drug Administration. CLOZARIL (clozapine) NDA 019758/S-061/S-077 Approval & Shared Clozapine REMS Elements to Assure Safe Use (21 CFR 314.520).
paperclip_tier3_pins.verified_fact: Mandates shared Clozapine REMS prescriber/pharmacy certification and pre-dispense ANC monitoring algorithms prior to dispensing narrow-therapeutic-index clozapine.
paperclip_tier3_pins.hal_role: Tier 0/1 Grounding for `Track` Lease Fencing Against Double-Dispensing (`G15` / `H-OCQ-01`)

hal_tiers.hal_name: Human Crew (`L3` Crewed Sailing Under Fixed Attention Budget)
hal_tiers.opencareq_component: NHS DCB0160 CSO (Defender) + PCN Pharmacist/Link Worker (Observer/Teammate) + Red-Team (Adversary) + 42-ICB Commissioning Council (Governor)
hal_tiers.action: Resolves ~1.29 national judgment calls/min (1.84 calls/hr/ICB) within 30 min/hr attention budget & teaches downward.

oversight_regimes.label: Full Automation (No Human Crew, Plain Protocol)
oversight_regimes.failure_mode: Silent unguarded clinical harm & spoofed/truncated prescribing.

oversight_regimes.label: Flat Uniform Stream Reader (Same 30 min/hr Budget, No Hierarchy)
oversight_regimes.failure_mode: 1,996,800 events/hr overwhelms uniform sampling (0.063% stream visibility).

oversight_regimes.label: Passive Watchtower Approval Queue (Bainbridge Vigilance Decay)
oversight_regimes.failure_mode: Approval fatigue >30 min causes rubber-stamp commission errors & queue backlog.

oversight_regimes.label: OpenCareQ HAL L3 Crewed Sailing + Teach Downward (6 NHS Layers)
oversight_regimes.failure_mode: None: clinicians stay crew (2.76/30.0 attention-min/hr/ICB) & compile overrides to Tier 1.
